newsitem.title: USA: USG Corp Q4 profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: USG Corp Q4 profit vs loss.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q4 1996 earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) $123 million vs $102 million.
Q4 1996 results after $42.0 million or $0.89/share charge for noncash amortization of excess reorganization value and reorganization debt discount.

Q4 1995 results after charges of $67 million or $1.49 a share. Charges includes non-cash amortization and $24.0 million after-tax charge related to sale of Thermaflex insulation business in the United States and the closure of an insulation business in Canada.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Full-year 1996 EBITDA $437.0 million vs $417.0 million.
Full-year 1996 results after $170 million or $3.58 a share noncash amortization charge.
Full-year 1995 results after $197 million or $4.38 a share in charges for noncash amortization and insulation businesses.
